# cato_dhcp_option (Resource)

Manages one standalone DHCP option via networkConfig.dhcp. Unrelated collection items remain unchanged. Requires NCS_DHCP_PUBLIC_API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cato_dhcp_option" "example" {
  tag   = 224
  type  = "ASCII"
  value = "example"
  # description = "Example DHCP option"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) DHCP option code.
- `type` (String) DHCP option encoding.
- `value` (String) Option value formatted according to type.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description; omit, null, or empty string clears it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Collection item IDs are opaque and must be preserved unchanged.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cato_dhcp_option.example OPAQUE_RESOURCE_ID
```
